title: A Systematic Literature Review of Digital Media in Enhancing Arabic Listening Comprehension
text_snippet: A Systematic Literature Review of Digital Media in Enhancing Arabic Listening Comprehension This study aims to map the use of digital media in enhancing Arabic listening skills and to identify research limitations in related studies published over the last five years (2022–2026). The study employed a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) method following the PRISMA guidelines to ensure a systematic and transparent process of literature selection and synthesis. Data were collected from three databases, namely Garuda, DOAJ, and ERIC. A total of 150 articles were initially identified, of which 13 met the inclusion criteria. The findings indicate that digital media used in Arabic listening instruction can be classified into four categories: audio-based media, audio visual media, Mobile-Assisted Language Learning (MALL), and Learning Management Systems (LMS). The review further reveals that audio visual media and MALL based applications demonstrate more consistent effectiveness in improving listening skills due to their integration of multimodal elements, interactivity, and structured feedback. title: Analysis of Arabic Language Madrasah Assessment Test Items Based on Educational Assessment Standards at Al-Ikhlas Nanggulan Islamic Senior High School
text_snippet: Analysis of Arabic Language Madrasah Assessment Test Items Based on Educational Assessment Standards at Al-Ikhlas Nanggulan Islamic Senior High School يُسهم تحليل أسئلة الاختبار في تحسين جودة منهج اللغة العربية من خلال الكشف عن جوانب القوة والضعف في عملية التقويم. يهدف هذا البحث إلى تحليل صدق الأسئلة وثباتها ومعاملات الصعوبة والتمييز للكشف عن جودة أسئلة اللغة العربية في الامتحان النهائي بمدرسة الإخلاص الثانوية الإسلامية نانغولان للعام الدراسي 2022–2023. اعتمد البحث المنهج الوصفي الكمي، وتكوّنت العينة من 40 سؤالًا من نوع الاختيار من متعدد، وجُمعت البيانات من إجابات 25 طالبًا باستخدام أسلوب التوثيق. وتم تحليل البيانات باستخدام معامل ارتباط بيرسون لقياس الصدق، ومعامل ألفا كرونباخ لقياس الثبات، ومؤشر الصعوبة(P) ، ومعامل التمييز(D). أظهرت النتائج أن جودة الأسئلة كانت جيدة بوجه عام؛ إذ بلغت نسبة الأسئلة الصادقة 65%، في حين بلغت نسبة الأسئلة غير الصادقة 35%. كما حققت الأسئلة درجة ثبات مرتفعة جدًا بمعامل ألفا كرونباخ قدره (0.915). ومن حيث الصعوبة، توزعت الأسئلة إلى 17.5% سهلة، و70% متوسطة، و12.5% صعبة. أما من حيث التمييز، فبلغت نسبة الأسئلة ذات التمييز الجيد 62.5%، والمتوسط 17.5%، والضعيف 12.5%، وغير المميزة 5%، في حين بلغت نسبة الأسئلة ذات التمييز السلبي 2.5%..

text_snippet: تعليم اللغة العربية القائم على مدخل الاستجابة الجسدية الكلية (Total Physical Response) للمبتدئين في مدرسة نور العلم المتوسطة المتكلملة ميدان Teaching Arabic Using the Total Physical Response (TPR) Approach to Beginners at Noor al-'Ilm Comprehensive Middle School, Medan يهدف هذا البحث إلى وصف تطبيق نهج الاستجابة الجسدية الشاملة (TPR) في تعليم اللغة العربية للطلاب المبتدئين في مدرسة مدرسة نورول إيلمي الإسلامية المتكاملة الإعدادية في ميدان بمدينة ميدان، وكذلك تحديد الآثار والعوامل الداعمة والعقبات التي تواجه تنفيذه. يستخدم هذا البحث نهجًا نوعيًا وصفيًا مع تقنيات لجمع البيانات من خلال الملاحظة والمقابلات والتوثيق. تتألف مجموعة المشاركين في البحث من مدير المدرسة، ومدرس اللغة العربية، والطلاب. تم تحليل البيانات باستخدام نموذج مايلز وهوبيرمان الذي يشمل تقليص البيانات، وعرض البيانات، واستخلاص الاستنتاجات. أظهرت نتائج البحث أن نهج TPR له تأثير إيجابي على تحسين فهم المفردات، ومستوى نشاط الطلاب، ودوافعهم للتعلم، وشجاعتهم في استخدام اللغة العربية. وقد دعم نجاح تطبيق نهج TPR كفاءة المعلمين وحماس الطلاب، فضلاً عن دعم البيئة المدرسية. أما العقبات التي تم تحديدها فتشمل تباين قدرات الطلاب، ومحدودية وقت التعلم، وانخفاض الثقة بالنفس لدى بعض الطلاب في المراحل الأولى. ومع ذلك، يمكن التغلب على هذه العقبات من خلال تكرار التعليمات، وتقديم الحوافز، وإدارة التعلم بما يتناسب مع احتياجات الطلاب.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Educational Psychology in Love-Based Arabic Language Learning
text_snippet: Artificial Intelligence and Educational Psychology in Love-Based Arabic Language Learning Learning Arabic as a Foreign Language (AFL) involves linguistic, pedagogical, and affective challenges, particularly foreign language anxiety. Artificial Intelligence (AI) can support personalization and immediate feedback, yet overly technology-centered instruction may weaken human interaction. This study aims to formulate a conceptual model integrating AI, educational psychology, and a love-based curriculum for holistic, learner-centered AFL learning. A qualitative-descriptive systematic literature review examined 26 scholarly sources, comprising recent peer-reviewed studies and foundational works, retrieved from Scopus, Web of Science, ERIC, Google Scholar, Garuda, and SINTA. The sources were synthesized through Braun and Clarke's six-stage thematic analysis. The findings indicate that AI supports diagnosis, personalization, adaptive practice, and feedback; educational psychology guides motivation, emotional regulation, autonomy, competence, relatedness, and cognitive-load management; and the love-based curriculum provides an ethical foundation for empathy, psychological safety, and meaningful teacher-student relationships. The study proposes an AI-Psychology-Love Synergy Model

text_snippet: فعالية و اتجاهات التعلم اللغوي المعزز بالهاتف المحمول (MALL)في تعليم اللغة العربية Effectiveness and Trends of Mobile-Assisted Language Learning (MALL) in Arabic Language Education يهدف هذا البحث إلى دراسة الاتجاهات، والفعالية، والتحديات في تطبيق التعلم اللغوي المدعوم بالهاتف المحمول (MALL)في تعليم اللغة العربية خلال الفترة من 2020 إلى 2025. يُعد MALL منهجًا في تعلم اللغات يعتمد على التكنولوجيا المحمولة، ويوفر مرونة وسهولة الوصول وتخصيصًا لعملية التعلم. استخدمت هذه الدراسة منهج مراجعة الأدبيات المنهجية (SLR) من خلال تحليل 42 مقالًا من قواعد بيانات دولية مختلفة ذات صلة بالموضوع. وأظهرت نتائج التحليل أن استخدام MALL يسهم بشكل ملحوظ في تعزيز المفردات، ومهارات التحدث والاستماع، وكذلك دافعية المتعلمين في تعلم اللغة العربية. وقد أثبتت تطبيقات مثل Duolingo، وE-Mufradat، وWhatsApp Learning فعاليتها في دعم التعلم السياقي والمستمر. ومع ذلك، لا تزال هناك تحديات، خاصة فيما يتعلق بمحدودية البنية التحتية، ونقص تدريب المعلمين، وتشتيت الانتباه الناتج عن استخدام الأجهزة المحمولة. وتخلص هذه الدراسة إلى أن MALL يمتلك إمكانات كبيرة في إحداث تحول في تعليم اللغة العربية، إلا أن تحقيق هذه الإمكانات يتطلب دعمًا سياسيًا، وتدريبًا مهنيًا، وتطويرًا لمحتوى محلي مناسب. وتقدم هذه النتائج دلالات مهمة للمربين، ومطوري التطبيقات، وصناع القرار في تصميم استراتيجيات تعلم مرنة ومعتمدة على التكنولوجيا.

title: Strategies of Arabic Language Teachers Using Instructional Media and Technology to Improve Students’ Reading Skills
text_snippet: Strategies of Arabic Language Teachers Using Instructional Media and Technology to Improve Students’ Reading Skills The development of instructional media and learning technologies requires Arabic language teachers to adapt relevant teaching strategies in order to enhance students’ language skills, particularly reading ability (al-qirā’ah). text_snippet: Enhancing Spontaneous Arabic Speaking through Task-Based Interaction Spontaneous Arabic speaking remains a major challenge for university students because many learners can understand grammatical rules and memorize dialogues but still hesitate to produce Arabic orally in unscripted interaction. title: Third Party Mediated Politeness in Salwa Bakr’s Short Story Zināt Fī Janāzat al-Ra'īs
text_snippet: Third Party Mediated Politeness in Salwa Bakr’s Short Story Zināt Fī Janāzat al-Ra'īs This study aims to analyze the representation of Brown and Levinson’s politeness strategies in third-party mediated speech in Salwa Bakr’s short story, Zināt Fī Janāzat al-Ra’īs. Employing a qualitative approach with a descriptive-analytical framework, the study analyzed the text using the extralinguistic correspondence method to associate linguistic components with the social context of the narrative. The analysis reveals that the mediator’s involvement manifests uniquely within each category of Brown and Levinson's strategies, altering the direct desires of the uneducated protagonist to navigate a strict social hierarchy. This linguistic alteration acts as a survival mechanism to protect the protagonist from state repression. The study ultimately concludes that in Bakr’s narrative, politeness toward authority emerges as a result of the scribe’s mediation rather than the speaker’s expression. This literary case study enhances sociopragmatic research by illustrating how class, literacy differences, and institutional obstacles influence politeness, providing a theoretical hypothesis for future empirical research in real-world professional, judicial, or community interpreting context

title: The Role of a Multilingual Environment in the Acquisition of Arabic as a Second Language
text_snippet: The Role of a Multilingual Environment in the Acquisition of Arabic as a Second Language This study aims to analyze the role of a multilingual environment in the acquisition of Arabic as a second language at Pondok Modern Arrisalah Ponorogo. title: Living the Language
text_snippet: Living the Language Arabic language education in pesantren-based Islamic universities increasingly emphasizes self-regulated learning to encourage authentic language use beyond formal classrooms. Ecocritical studies of Arab-Indonesian religious poetry remain relatively limited, particulary those that explore natural symbolism in the works of Indonesia’s archipelago scholars. This research positions literature as a moral-spiritual medium for fostering ecological awareness amid environmental degradation in Indonesia, such as air, marine, and terrestrial pollution. title: What Is the Arabic Verb for…?
text_snippet: What Is the Arabic Verb for…? Arabic language education in Malaysia continues to develop in response to increasing demands for communicative competence and access to Islamic knowledge. However, many learners still struggle to recall basic Arabic verbs during spontaneous communication despite years of instruction. This study examines the effectiveness of guessing-based learning in improving Arabic verb retention among Malaysian learners. A classroom-based quasi-experimental mixed-methods design was employed, involving an experimental group exposed to structured guessing activities and a comparison group receiving conventional instruction. Quantitative data were collected through pre-tests and post-tests, while qualitative data were obtained from classroom observations and interviews. title: Optimalisasi Memori dalam Pembelajaran Bahasa Arab: Kajian Neuropsikolinguistik Memory Optimization in Arabic Language Learning
text_snippet: Optimalisasi Memori dalam Pembelajaran Bahasa Arab: Kajian Neuropsikolinguistik Memory Optimization in Arabic Language Learning Teaching Arabic to non-native speakers poses various challenges, ranging from differences in writing systems to grammatical and pronunciation complexities. In addressing these challenges, memory plays a crucial role as a cognitive component underlying language acquisition processes. This study aims to explore the role of memory in Arabic language learning from a neuropsycholinguistic perspective. The research employed a library research method with content analysis. Findings indicate that the hippocampus serves as a vital memory processing center in language learning. Understanding the types of memorysensory, short-term, and long-term provides a foundation for developing more effective teaching strategies. Mnemonic techniques, multisensory approaches, and meaningful learning are proven to optimize memory functions, enhance retention, and strengthen students' Arabic language skills. These findings offer practical implications for teachers and curriculum developers in designing memory-based teaching methods.

title: The Phenomenon of Digital Media Use in Arabic Langauge Learning at Secondary School
text_snippet: The Phenomenon of Digital Media Use in Arabic Langauge Learning at Secondary School This study examines the phenomenon of digital media use in Arabic language learning at secondary schools from a digital psychology perspective, focusing on students' attention, memory, and motivation. Utilizing a descriptive qualitative method, data was collected via interviews, observation, and documentation. Findings indicate that digital media, such as Canva based visuals, interactive animations, and digital quizzes, effectively attracted student attention and enhanced motivation compared to conventional methods. This multisensory approach facilitated material comprehension and strengthened vocabulary and sentence structure retention. From a digital psychology perspective, these media fostered emotional engagement, promoting active, consistent, and reflective learning. Despite technical constraints like limited data and mobile phone regulations, student preference for digital media remained high, leading to increased focus, participation, and motivation. This study confirms the significant role of digital media in improving student attention, memory, and learning motivation, emphasizing proper utilization and digital literacy for an effective and engaging learning experience.

title: A Balāghah Analysis of Majāz Mursal Usage in the Verses of the Qur’an, Juz 14
text_snippet: A Balāghah Analysis of Majāz Mursal Usage in the Verses of the Qur’an, Juz 14 The language used in the Qur’an represents the most beautiful form of the Arabic language, and no written work is able to equal its eloquence. Among the aspects of this linguistic beauty is the extensive use of rhetorical devices, one of which is majaz mursal, found in the verses of the Qur’an, particularly in the fourteenth juz. The purpose of this study is to identify the verses in the fourteenth juz that contain majaz mursal and to analyze them based on the various types of ‘alaqah. The research employs a qualitative approach using a descriptive-analytical method. The findings indicate that there are twenty-six verses in the fourteenth juz that contain majaz mursal, distributed across Surah Al-Ḥijr and An-Naḥl. The types of ‘alaqah identified include juz’iyyah, kulliyyah, mahaliyyah, ḥāliyyah, musabbabiyyah, and al-umūm. These findings demonstrate that majaz mursal enriches the meaning of the Qur’an and deepens the understanding of divine messages, serving as a bridge between linguistic beauty and the depth of meaning that characterizes the Qur’anic style.

title: Enhancing Arabic Writing and Literacy through Ibda’ Magazine: A Culturally Relevant Medium in Islamic Boarding Schools
text_snippet: Enhancing Arabic Writing and Literacy through Ibda’ Magazine: A Culturally Relevant Medium in Islamic Boarding Schools In Arabic language education, writing remains one of the most underdeveloped yet essential skills, particularly for non-native learners who often excel in grammar drills but struggle to produce coherent and expressive texts. This study explores the role of Ibdaâ€™ Magazine as an authentic, student-centered platform to enhance Arabic writing skills and literacy among 60 third-year Tsanawiyah students at Pondok Pesantren Darullughah Waddaâ€™wah. Using a qualitative descriptive design, the research draws on thematic analysis of student writings, classroom observations, and semi-structured interviews with both learners and instructors. The findings reveal significant improvement in students' vocabulary use, grammatical accuracy, narrative coherence, and stylistic expression. Additionally, learners reported increased confidence, motivation, and a deeper sense of ownership over their Arabic writing. The study affirms that culturally relevant, print-based media can serve as powerful pedagogical tools in bridging the gap between formal instruction and meaningful language practice, offering new pathways for Arabic writing development in Islamic educational settings.

text_snippet: Exploring Social and Academic Motivations Behind High School Graduates Selection of Arabic Language Menggali Motivasi Sosial dan Akademik di Balik Pemilihan Bahasa Arab oleh Lulusan Sekolah Menengah Atas This study explores the motivations of high school alumni in choosing the Arabic Language Education program at IAIN Kerinci, as well as the factors influencing their decision to select this major. A qualitative method with a descriptive analysis approach was employed. The findings reveal that students from non-boarding school backgrounds select the Arabic Language major for three main reasons: (a) religious motives, where they study Arabic to understand and teach Islamic teachings (fahm al-maqru); (b) academic motives, where they aim to comprehend Arabic sciences and skills (istimaâ€™, kalam, qiraâ€™ah, and kitabah); and (c) professional, practical, and pragmatic motives, such as becoming a teacher and communicating orally (muhadatsah) in Arabic. This research presents a novelty by refuting Herdah (2020) findings, showing that not all Arabic learners study the language for ideological and economic reasons. These insights offer a new perspective on the diverse motivations behind studying Arabic, providing a comprehensive understanding of their motivations.

title: Implementation of Multisensory Strategies in Arabic Language Learning for Students with Phonological Disorders: A Literature Review
text_snippet: Implementation of Multisensory Strategies in Arabic Language Learning for Students with Phonological Disorders: A Literature Review This study is a literature review aimed at identifying effective instructional strategies for teaching Arabic to students with phonological disorders. Although numerous studies have addressed Arabic language instruction and phonological therapy separately, the integration of the two remains limited. This research adopts a narrative literature review approach by analyzing scholarly articles published between 2020 and 2025, sourced from databases such as Scopus, Google Scholar, ScienceDirect, ResearchGate, and Garuda Kemdikbud. The findings indicate that multisensory strategies, phonology-based phonetic exercises, and the use of interactive technologies (such as audio-visual media and educational applications) are effective in enhancing students' abilities to recognize, differentiate, and produce sounds in Arabic. The review also highlights the importance of individualized interventions and collaboration between teachers and speech therapists in designing inclusive instruction. These findings provide a conceptual foundation for the development of Arabic language instruction that is responsive to the needs of students with special educational needs.

title: Pengaruh Artificial Intelligence (AI) terhadap Willingness to Communicate pada Pembelajaran Bahasa Arab The Effect of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on Willingness to Communicate in Arabic Language Learning
text_snippet: Pengaruh Artificial Intelligence (AI) terhadap Willingness to Communicate pada Pembelajaran Bahasa Arab The Effect of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on Willingness to Communicate in Arabic Language Learning Rendahnya Willingness to Communicate (WTC) dalam pembelajaran bahasa Arab menjadi hambatan dalam penguasaan kompetensi komunikatif, yang disebabkan oleh rendahnya kepercayaan diri. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh penggunaan AI terhadap WTC mahasiswa dalam pembelajaran bahasa Arab. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif. Data dikumpulkan melalui kuesioner berbasis skala Likert yang mengukur aspek WTC, kepercayaan diri, dan motivasi. Sampel terdiri dari mahasiswa program studi Pendidikan bahasa Arab di beberapa universitas, dengan teknik random area sampling. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa AI memiliki pengaruh positif signifikan terhadap WTC, dengan menciptakan lingkungan belajar yang mendukung, interaktif, dan adaptif. AI memberikan umpan balik personal yang membantu meningkatkan kepercayaan diri mahasiswa. Teknologi berbasis AI berperan penting dalam meningkatkan WTC dan mendukung keberhasilan pembelajaran bahasa Arab. Penelitian ini memberikan dasar bagi pengembangan strategi pedagogis berbasis teknologi serta menekankan pentingnya meningkatkan WTC dalam keberhasilan pembelajaran bahasa Arab.

title: The Influence of the Role-Playing Method on the Arabic Speaking Skills of Students at Al-Ghuraba Islamic Boarding School, Dompu.
text_snippet: The Influence of the Role-Playing Method on the Arabic Speaking Skills of Students at Al-Ghuraba Islamic Boarding School, Dompu. The low proficiency in Arabic speaking skills among students at Al-Ghuraba Islamic Boarding School, Dompu, presents a significant challenge in language learning processes. This study aims to analyze the effect of implementing the role-playing method on enhancing students' Arabic speaking skills. A quantitative approach was applied, employing a pre-experimental design of the one-group pretest-posttest type. Data were collected by examining the correlation between pretest and posttest scores following the intervention. The analysis revealed a very high correlation value of 0.86, indicating a significant impact of the role-playing method on speaking skill improvement. These findings suggest that the role-playing method fosters a more active and communicative learning environment, while also boosting studentsâ€™ confidence in practical Arabic usage. The study highlights the need for broader application of the role-playing method to support the development of Arabic speaking skills within Islamic boarding schools.

title: The Use of Conceptual Metaphors in the Translation of Kitab Al-Hikam by D.A. Pakih Sati by Ibn ‘Aṭāillah Al-Sakandarī
text_snippet: The Use of Conceptual Metaphors in the Translation of Kitab Al-Hikam by D.A. Pakih Sati by Ibn ‘Aṭāillah Al-Sakandarī This research aims to analyze the use of conceptual metaphors in the translation of Al-Hikam by D.A. Pakih Sati, originally written by Ibn ‘Aṭāillah Al-Sakandarī. The method used is descriptive qualitative to identify and classify conceptual metaphors based on the theory of Lakoff and Johnson. The research data consists of twenty-one conceptual metaphors divided into three main types: 13 ontological metaphors, 5 structural metaphors, and 3 orientational metaphors. The results of the analysis show the dominance of ontological metaphors in this translation, which conceptualize experiences and processes in metaphorical language relying on pre-conceptualized meanings in the mind. The implications of this research provide a deeper understanding of how conceptual metaphors are used in the context of translating spiritual texts, as well as their contribution to the comprehension and interpretation of classical texts in religious culture.

title: Implementation of the Drill Method in Arabic Language Learning at the Elementary Madrasah of the Ummusshabri
text_snippet: Implementation of the Drill Method in Arabic Language Learning at the Elementary Madrasah of the Ummusshabri This study aims to describe how the application of the drill method in Arabic language learning at the Madrasah Ibtidaiyyah Pesantren Ummusshbari Kendari. The type of research used is a qualitative descriptive approach using data collection techniques through interviews, observations and documentation. The data analysis method used by the author through three stages, namely data reduction, data presentation and drawing conclusions. The results of the study indicate that the application of the drill method in Arabic language learning at the Madrasah Ibtidaiyyah Pesantren Ummusshabri Kendari that teachers have implemented the drill method well in the learning process in the classroom. There are several stages that must be carried out by the teacher, namely the preparation stage, implementation of learning and evaluation of learning. Supporting factors are the availability of adequate facilities such as television and textbooks and a whiteboard. While the inhibiting factor is the lack of interest in learning for students. Further research can examine Arabic language learning based on differentiation as an effort to understand each student's ability in learning.

title: The Feasibility of TOAFL Instrument as a Measuring Tool for Reading Skills of Students Faculty of Education
text_snippet: The Feasibility of TOAFL Instrument as a Measuring Tool for Reading Skills of Students Faculty of Education Evaluation of Arabic language learning requires a valid and reliable instrument to measure students' abilities accurately. This study aims to analyze the feasibility of the ITMAM (Ikhtibar Tahdid Mustawa al-'Arabiyyah lil Muta'allimin) instrument as a measuring tool for the Arabic reading skills of STITMA Yogyakarta students. The research method uses a descriptive quantitative approach by analyzing 60 questions tested on 311 students using SPSS version 25 software to test validity, reliability, level of difficulty and discriminatory power. Analysis is needed to ensure the quality of the test instrument that can provide accurate measurement results and become the basis for effective learning evaluation. The results showed that all questions were valid and reliable, with 65% having a moderate difficulty level, 37.7% at an easy level and 3.3% at a difficult level. The results of the Discriminatory Power Test showed that 60% of the questions were accepted well and 40% needed revision so the ITMAM instrument is suitable for use as a standard evaluation tool for Arabic reading ability with several improvements to certain questions.
